basic_info.description: Discover urban elegance at its finest in this exceptional San Francisco condo. Boasting 3 spacious bedrooms, and 2 baths, including a serene primary suite, this residence is bathed in abundant natural light. The open-concept layout seamlessly connects living spaces, perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. Step out onto your private balcony, or retreat to the expansive roof deck, where breathtaking views of downtown San Francisco await. Nestled in a highly desirable location, you're just steps away from vibrant shops and convenient public transportation. A lifestyle of convenience and sophistication awaits at 880 Presidio Ave.
